The butterfly is slightly above center, within a thin golden oval frame. The number "VII" is on the right side of the frame. The background is beige paper.

artworks.title: Plate 80: Purple and Yellow Viola

artworks.description: The image shows a circular, thin, golden line with a flower inside. The flower has purple and creamy yellow petals and green leaves. The color scheme includes soft cream and golden tones, purple, yellow, and green, against a neutral, textured background. The flower is positioned on the right side of the circle, slightly above the horizontal center line.

artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)

artworks.description: This image shows an ornate title page. The title "ANIMALIA QUADRUPEDIA ET REPTILIA" is in the center in classical lettering. The design features decorative motifs such as scrollwork, floral patterns, and ribbons. At the top, there is a small emblem labeled "TERRA" with a landscape illustration. The color scheme includes pastel colors with earth tones. A Latin phrase is displayed in a ribbon-like frame towards the bottom.

artworks.title: Plate 9: A Donkey and a Mule
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two donkeys standing on a grass patch with trees in an illustrative style. The image shows a larger donkey on the left and a smaller donkey on the right. Above the donkeys, there are Latin phrases written on blue ribbons intertwined with branches. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame. The background is a plain, off-white color, emphasizing the central oval where the donkeys and environmental details are rendered with fine brushwork showcasing texture and depth.

artworks.title: Plate 10: A Lion and a Civet Cat
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 11: A Lioness with Two Lions in the Background
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two lions interacting in a landscape. In this artwork, one lion is seen relaxing in the foreground, licking and grooming itself with its leg raised, while the other lion stands on a rock. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame, on a landscape of grass and a bare tree branch arches over the scene. Above the lions, there is Latin text. This is in the style of a classical or Renaissance illustrator.

artworks.title: Plate 12: A Cheetah(?) and a Wild Sheep
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a spotted leopard and a small antelope on a grassy terrain. The leopard is on the left side in profile with a curved tail and large spots. On the right, a light-colored antelope with short horns is on the ground. The background is minimalist with an oval frame. Inscriptions above and below the scene read "SEMPE ALIQVID NOVI ADFFERT AFRICA" and "PARDI MORS" respectively. This painting is in the style of Johannes Stradanus.

artworks.title: Plate 13: A Tiger, a Lynx, and a Jaguar(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three different wild cats on a grassy terrain with a cactus. The image illustrates a tiger, a lynx, and a leopard within a circular composition. The tiger stands on a patch of green grass. Above the tiger, the lynx is on a tree branch. The leopard is crouching on the right side near a cactus. Latin text is scripted above and below the image. The number "XIII" is written on the right side. The drawing combines artistic skill with a zoological study aspect.

artworks.title: Plate 14: A Civet, a Lynx, and a Hyena Eating a Dog
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a detailed illustration featuring three wild animals positioned within an oval frame, with decorative text above and below the image. The painting includes a large cat-like creature standing prominently on the ground, a smaller animal atop a tree branch, and another actively feasting on prey in the grass. The background is a simple depiction of grassy land with a tree branch extending into the scene. Text in Latin appears above and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 15: A Bear and a Lynx(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bear and a lynx facing each other in a natural setting. The image depicts a bear on the left, with its head bowed towards the ground, and a lynx on the right standing upright. Both animals are surrounded by park-like scenery, with branches extending into the circular frame from the left and right sides. The top and bottom of the frame feature Latin text.

artworks.title: Plate 16: Wild Boar
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a wild boar in a forest setting. The painting depicts a dark-colored boar standing amidst a natural scenery, with its gaze forward as it stands atop rocky terrain. Surrounding the boar are leafy trees on either side, and beneath it runs a suggestion of a flowing stream. The water appears vibrant and slightly tumultuous, captured with a bluish hue. The boar is shown with its mouth slightly open, displaying a sense of movement and alertness. Latin text is adorned above, adding a classical touch to the artwork. This is in the style of a Renaissance or early naturalist artist.

artworks.title: Plate 17: Old World Porcupine (Hystrix) and Wild Pig
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting showing a porcupine and a pig on a patch of rocky brown-and-green ground within an oval border. Both animals are of similar sizes, and they are facing the left, so we see them in profile. The porcupine is on the left, displaying its long black-and-white quills, and the pig is on the right with a short, curly tail and patterned fur in shades of reddish-brown, yellow, black, and cream. A branch with two ripe peaches is depicted above them, coming in from the right. The scene is encircled by a thin brown border, and the top contains Latin script reading "MATREM SEQVIMINI PORCI," with the number "XVII" on the right side. The background is plain, off-white paper.

artworks.title: Plate 18: A Pig with Acorns
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pig standing on a patch of ground. The pig is detailed with precise lines and shading. It is depicted on a small patch of ground within an oval frame. Above the pig are branches with green leaves and acorns. Latin text is present on the painting, including "QVID CVM AMARACINO SVÍ?" and “SVS LOTA AD VOLVTABRVM COENI”. A Roman numeral “XVIII.” is on the right side. The painting focuses on anatomical details and naturalistic textures, reminiscent of botanical or zoological illustrations from the 16th or 17th century.

artworks.title: Plate 1: Elephant with Insects
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 19: Four Types of Stags
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring four deer in a natural setting. The deer are positioned in a circular vignette surrounded by inscriptions in Latin. The central deer stands prominently in the foreground with tall antlers. To the left, another deer stands atop a small hill, while a third lies resting with antlers. On the right, a fourth deer is partially obscured by a tree trunk. The background shows green slopes. The overall composition captures the forms of the deer. The style resembles a natural history illustration from the Renaissance period, attributed to artists such as Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Plate 20: Three Types of Stags with a Dormouse(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three deer and a small rodent-like creature within a circular frame. The central focus of the image is on three distinct deer positioned within a circle, each numbered for identification. The deer on the left has smaller, straight antlers and appears to be standing still, the central deer has its head lowered as if grazing or sniffing the ground, and the deer on the right with larger antlers is partially concealed behind a tree trunk on the right side of the circle. Below these creatures is a small rodent also numbered, situated near the foreground on grassy terrain. The trees and animals are delicately colored with fine attention to detail, emphasizing their texture and form. Around this circular composition, Latin text is inscribed at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Plate 21: Reindeer with Melons
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a reindeer with antlers standing on a grassy mound. Above the reindeer are two split green fruits hanging from a vine, revealing a red interior. The color palette includes shades of brown, tan, green, and yellow-brown.

artworks.title: Plate 22: Blackhead Persian Sheep and a Sheep with a Long Tail, with a Cactus
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts a large sheep with a black face and white body standing on the left side. A smaller sheep with a lighter face is standing on a bluish rock slightly to its right. A green prickly cactus with purple flowers grows on a small hill to the far right. The color palette includes natural earthy tones with the sheep in shades of black, white, and gray, the cactus in green, the rock in blue, and the ground in muted browns and yellows. The large sheep is positioned on the left, the smaller sheep is near the center on a blue rock, and the cactus is on the far right, sitting on a mound of earth.

artworks.title: Plate 23: A Fat-Tailed Sheep, a Sheep with a Long Tail, a "Cassia purgatrix,"and Other Plants
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two sheep and some plants. The drawing depicts a scene with two sheep set against a pastoral landscape. The central sheep is resting its forelegs against a mound, adorned with a plant that appears to have thin vertical stems and small blooms. Another smaller sheep is depicted grazing in the background to the left. The composition is framed by two branches with leaves on either side of the image, each holding different types of fruit or pods. At the top of the drawing, there is text in Latin: "Oves Lupo Commitisae."

artworks.title: Plate 24: A Wild Goat and a Barbary Sheep(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two goats on a rocky terrain. The goats have different fur colors and horn shapes and are surrounded by Latin inscriptions. The painting is in the style of a traditional Renaissance botanical or zoological illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 25: Two Wild Goats
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two goats on a rocky landscape. One goat stands on a rock while the other is balanced on a different peak. The rocks are in shades of blue and green, creating a rugged terrain. There is text in Latin inscribed above them. The scene is framed within a circular boundary against a plain background. The style is reminiscent of Basilius Besler.

artworks.title: Plate 26: A Red Fox and a Wolf
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fox and a wolf interacting within a circular frame. The image shows two animals, a fox and a wolf, placed on a small grassy terrain encircled by a thin golden line. The fox is positioned to the left, with the wolf approaching it from behind on the right. The wolf has its mouth slightly open. Above the animals, Latin text appears. A tree with branches and leaves takes up the right side of the frame. The style emphasizes realism combined with symbolic elements.
